name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Shod on a mount, it glides above the ground, leaves no tracks and never tires.
text: A set of four iron shoes that work only when a horse or similar creature wears all four on its hooves. The shod creature moves normally while hovering 4 inches off the ground, so it can walk on or stand over water, lava and other nonsolid or unsteady footing. It leaves no tracks, ignores Difficult Terrain and can keep traveling for as long as 12 hours each day without gaining Exhaustion from a long journey. (In the game, they make the party's journeys a third faster.)
